title: Our Story
lead: Pehnawa by SS was born from a shared passion for Indian textiles and a desire to make exquisite traditional wear accessible to every woman.
body:
Founded by **Sandhya Jain** and **Shalini Sottany**, we curate and handcraft clothing that celebrates the rich heritage of Indian craftsmanship — from grand bridal lehengas to elegant party wear and comfortable everyday kurtis.

Each piece in our collection is thoughtfully designed to blend timeless tradition with contemporary silhouettes, so you feel confident and beautiful at every occasion.
